title: Reconstruction of solutions to abstract Schrodinger, diffusion, and wave-type equations from snapshots
summary: It is shown that if one knows "sufficiently many" snapshots (samples) from an individual solution of a Schrödinger-type equation-which is bandlimited in an appropriate sense-then the solution can be reconstructed by a simple formula similar to the Shannon formula for bandlimited signals. Furthermore, results demonstrate that by using snapshots of bandlimited solutions of a Schrödinger-type equation, one can reconstruct bandlimited solutions of some relevant diffusion- and wave-type equations.
